messages:

Subject: Execution timeline & final clean copies — Redwood MSA + Order Form

Hi Monica,

Thanks for getting the redlines turned around. Procurement is ready to schedule signature this week but we need: 1) a confirmed DocuSign routing plan (sequential vs parallel), 2) the final clean PDFs you intend to send for signature, and 3) confirmation of authorized signers on your side.

Two items from our side: our Treasury team requires the PO to be attached to the signed Order Form for payment, and EU operations has asked whether a witness/notary will be required for the CFO signature. Happy to provide names once you confirm routing.

Attached: Brightwell_PO_4532.pdf

Can we get a proposed envelope and timeline today so we can lock a signing window?

Best,
Janelle Park
Head of Contracts, Brightwell Health
[Attachment: Brightwell_PO_4532.pdf (PDF)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution timeline & final clean copies — Redwood MSA + Order Form

Hi Janelle —

Appreciate the quick heads-up. Proposed plan below:

- Docs we will send for signature (stubs attached): MSA_clean_v3.pdf, OrderForm_Brightwell_v2.pdf
- Routing: sequential signing (Brightwell signs first → Redwood signs second). We recommend sequential so we can verify signatory authority on our end before countersignature.
- Signers needed from Brightwell: CFO (electronic signature) + Procurement lead (acceptance). If Brightwell needs a notary or in-person witness, please flag which signer requires it.
- Timeline: envelope created Monday morning (07/13), Brightwell signing window Mon afternoon → Tue morning; Redwood to countersign Tue afternoon when we confirm authority.

Action items for you: please confirm the Brightwell signer names and emails and whether a notary/witness is required. Also confirm you want the PO attached as an exhibit to the Order Form — we can include it in the envelope.

Attachments (for signature prep): MSA_clean_v3.pdf, OrderForm_Brightwell_v2.pdf

I will loop in Legal (Laura) on execution language checks before we create the envelope.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: MSA_clean_v3.pdf (PDF), OrderForm_Brightwell_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@brightwell.com>

Cc: Brightwell Procurement <po@brightwell.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0400

Thanks Monica — see signer info below. We do require the PO to be part of the signed package. Notary: our CFO prefers a witnessed signature for the EU entity (Brightwell Health EU).

Signers:
- Lina Moreno, CFO <lina.moreno@brightwell.com> (requires witness)
- Arjun Singh, Procurement Lead <arjun.singh@brightwell.com>

We can accept sequential signing. Please include the PO inside the envelope as an exhibit. If you can provide a fallback signer for Redwood in case the designated signer is unavailable, that would be helpful.

Thanks — we are ready to proceed once routing is confirmed.

Best,
Janelle
[Attachment: Brightwell_PO_4532.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Execution timeline & final clean copies — Redwood MSA + Order Form

Monica / Ben —

I reviewed the final clean and have two modest execution requests before we push envelope:

1) Execution block: please use the EU entity name exactly as defined in the MSA (Brightwell Health EU S.à r.l.) and add a signer title line that captures capacity (e.g., "for and on behalf of Brightwell Health EU S.à r.l., by Lina Moreno, CFO").
2) Fallback signer: add a conditional role in the envelope labeled "Redwood Executive - Alternate" (this must be a named Redwood officer) so we avoid delays if the primary signer is unavailable.

We are comfortable with sequential routing. If Brightwell needs a witnessed signature, include a "Witness" role after the Brightwell CFO signature. We will countersign electronically after witness confirmation.

I'll attach a short execution checklist and the language we prefer for the execution block.

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Execution_Instructions.docx (DOCX)]

- HubSpot: I linked the envelope to RDW-2026-0173 (HubSpot deal).

Attachments in the envelope will be visible to signers except Execution_Instructions.docx (internal). We will add a DocuSign field for the witness name and a free-text field for any witness confirmation notes.

If that all looks good, I'll create the envelope Wednesday morning and add Marissa as Redwood primary signer.

Thanks,
